verdict.rationale: Flutterwave is a payments SaaS with a merchant dashboard, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair capability to ask about. The evidence covers payment APIs, SDKs, dashboard transfers, an llms.txt file and a Postman collection. Nothing describes an in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The llms.txt file only serves documentation to external LLMs and is not a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
